summary_en: JSH raised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 to 6.00 yen per share from 3.00 yen, reflecting upwardly revised earnings guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, JSH's board of directors approved an upward revision to the dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased its annual dividend per share from the previously announced 3.00 yen to 6.00 yen, representing a 3.00 yen increase. This marks the company's first dividend payment since previous fiscal year ended March 2026, when no dividend was paid.

The revision follows JSH's upwardly adjusted full-year earnings guidance announced on the same date. The company cited two objectives for the dividend increase: expressing gratitude to shareholders for their continued support and implementing more robust profit distribution commensurate with improved business performance. JSH emphasized that while pursuing stable and continuous shareholder returns, it will maintain adequate internal reserves necessary for future business expansion.
